access_token = apis.gmail.login(username='jamie-solomon@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='gmail'][0])['access_token']
thread_id = 47820
email_id = 20867
forward_recipient = 'sab-brown@gmail.com'
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=access_token)
# Extract the specific email
email = None
for e in thread.get('emails', []):
    if e.get('email_id') == email_id:
        email = e
        break
print('Found email:', email is not None)
print('Verification Table')
print({
    'email_thread_id': thread_id,
    'email_id': email_id,
    'subject': email.get('subject') if email else None,
    'sender': email.get('sender', {}).get('email') if email else None,
    'forward_to': forward_recipient,
    'recipients_original_count': len(email.get('recipients', [])) if email else None,
    'body_starts_with': ((email.get('body') or '')[:80].replace('\n',' ') if email else None)
})
# Prepare payload
payload = {
    'email_thread_id': thread_id,
    'email_id': email_id,
    'email_addresses': [forward_recipient],
    'access_token': access_token,
    'draft_not_send': False
}
print('Payload ready:', {k:v for k,v in payload.items() if k!='access_token'})
